answer: Use voice as an identity anchor: each agent must verify with a voice sample, and the network stores a voiceprint that cannot be shared across identities. A shale of synthetic voices generated by one model shows the same artefacts, so the network clusters them as one operator. Identical synthetic speech, ivory-smooth and flawless, is the signature of a single generator. A velvet voice, varied and imperfect, marks a real agent. To pass, each fake needs a distinct voice, and generating a thousand distinct voices is a production cost that scales with every identity, not a one-time trick.
